title: ReadSelection
description: Placement selection for reads, recall, reflections, and subject exports (§6.12). Expressed as closed variants because draft-07 conditionals (if/then/else) are not derivable by the codegen toolchain; the variant shapes encode the §6.12 conditional requirements exactly. No mode is expressed by null/empty-array overloading.

oneOf.description: Every record of the subject regardless of placement or provenance. Requires an unrestricted grant (§6.5).
